ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in 3 equal instalments of Rs 2,000 each

who_does_NOT_qualify.description: Retired pensioner with monthly pension > Rs 10,000

application_steps: Step 1: Go to pmkisan.gov.in. Step 2: Click on New Farmer Registration. Step 3: Enter Aadhaar and details. Step 4: Submit land documents.
rejection_reasons: Bank account not linked to Aadhaar

common_faqs.q: Why is my payment stopped?
common_faqs.a: It may be due to a pending eKYC or Aadhaar-Bank seeding issue.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Insurance coverage for crop loss due to natural calamities

who_qualifies.description: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

application_steps: Step 1: Contact your local cooperative bank or insurance agent. Step 2: Fill out the proposal form for the specific crop season. Step 3: Pay the premium share.

common_faqs.q: How do I report crop loss?
common_faqs.a: Report the loss within 72 hours via the Crop Insurance app or your local agriculture office.

benefit: Financial assistance of Rs 1.20 lakh for house construction

who_qualifies.description: Families living in zero, one, or two-room kutcha houses

who_does_NOT_qualify.description: Families with a member earning > Rs 10,000/month

application_steps: Step 1: Check your name in the PMAY-G beneficiary list at the Gram Panchayat. Step 2: Provide documents to the local village head/block office.

common_faqs.q: How is the money given?
common_faqs.a: Directly into your bank account in 3 stages based on house construction progress.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit: Health coverage of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care

who_qualifies.description: Eligible for health coverage based on deprivation criteria

application_steps: Step 1: Check eligibility on the PMJAY portal. Step 2: Visit a district hospital or empanelled hospital with your documents to get the Ayushman card.

common_faqs.q: Is the treatment free?
common_faqs.a: Yes, cashless treatment is available at empanelled public and private hospitals.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Analysis of soil quality to suggest appropriate fertilizer dosage
application_steps: Step 1: Contact your local agricultural department office. Step 2: Soil samples are collected from your field. Step 3: Receive report via app or post.

common_faqs.q: How often should I get my soil tested?
common_faqs.a: Every 2-3 years to maintain soil health.

benefit: Debt relief on crop loans for eligible farmers

who_qualifies.description: Small and marginal farmers of Punjab

application_steps: Step 1: Fill out the application form at your local bank or SDM office. Step 2: Government verifies the loan details with the bank.

common_faqs.q: Does this cover private money lenders?
common_faqs.a: No, it only covers loans from cooperative and commercial banks.

ministry: Department of New and Renewable Energy, Punjab
benefit: Subsidy for installation of solar-powered irrigation pumps

who_qualifies.description: Farmers not connected to the electricity grid

application_steps: Step 1: Apply on the Punjab PEDA portal. Step 2: Department inspects land feasibility. Step 3: Install pump after approval.

common_faqs.q: Is the subsidy provided upfront?
common_faqs.a: The subsidy is provided as a discount on the installation cost.

benefit: Subsidy on farm equipment like Happy Seeder and Straw Management machinery

who_qualifies.description: Farmers or custom hiring centers in Punjab

application_steps: Step 1: Apply during open calls on the agriculture department website. Step 2: Selected through lottery/merit. Step 3: Purchase machinery and submit invoice.

common_faqs.q: Can I buy any machine?
common_faqs.a: Only specific models approved by the government are eligible for subsidy.

scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Khet Suraksha Yojana
benefit: Subsidy to install solar-powered fencing to protect crops from wild animals

who_qualifies.description: Farmers in districts affected by wild animal conflict

application_steps: Step 1: Submit application to District Agriculture Officer. Step 2: Field verification by authorities. Step 3: Install fencing after approval.

common_faqs.q: How much subsidy is given?
common_faqs.a: The government covers up to 60% of the cost.

benefit: Monthly pension for elderly small and marginal farmers

who_qualifies.description: Small and marginal farmers of UP

application_steps: Step 1: Apply through the Jan Seva Kendra. Step 2: Verification of age and land holding.

common_faqs.q: How much is the monthly amount?
common_faqs.a: Amounts vary based on specific state notifications.

scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Agriculture Export Promotion Policy
benefit: Subsidies for transport and infrastructure for exporting agricultural products

who_does_NOT_qualify.description: Individual farmers not part of a registered group

application_steps: Step 1: Register with the state export cell. Step 2: Submit details of export shipments.

common_faqs.q: Does this cover all crops?
common_faqs.a: No, only specifically identified export-oriented crops.

benefit: Financial assistance for crop damage due to natural disasters

who_does_NOT_qualify.description: Farmers not registered on the portal

application_steps: Step 1: Register on the Bihar agriculture portal. Step 2: Apply for compensation in the event of crop loss.

common_faqs.q: Is this different from PMFBY?
common_faqs.a: Yes, this is the state-specific assistance program.

benefit: Subsidy on diesel costs for irrigation during drought-like conditions

who_qualifies.description: Farmers in drought-notified districts of Bihar

application_steps: Step 1: Apply on the Bihar agriculture portal. Step 2: Upload fuel receipts. Step 3: Amount credited to bank account.

common_faqs.q: Can I claim for all crops?
common_faqs.a: Primarily for paddy and other water-intensive crops during low rainfall.

benefit: Subsidy for establishing custom hiring centers for farm machinery
application_steps: Step 1: Apply through the Bihar agriculture portal. Step 2: Get verified by the district committee.

common_faqs.q: What kind of machines can we buy?
common_faqs.a: Tractors, rotavators, and harvesters for renting to small farmers.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Subsidy for micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler) setup

who_does_NOT_qualify.description: Farmers with no source of water

application_steps: Step 1: Apply via state agriculture portal. Step 2: Field assessment by the department. Step 3: Subsidized installation.

common_faqs.q: Does it cover the pump set cost?
common_faqs.a: It focuses on the micro-irrigation system (pipes, emitters, etc.).

benefit: Short-term credit for crop production at low interest rates
application_steps: Step 1: Visit your nearest commercial or cooperative bank. Step 2: Fill the KCC application form. Step 3: Bank processes credit limit.

common_faqs.q: What is the interest rate?
common_faqs.a: Usually 7%, with subvention for prompt repayment.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Assistance for high-yielding seeds and farm technology adoption

who_qualifies.description: Farmers in notified districts for specific crops

application_steps: Step 1: Register at the local agriculture department office. Step 2: Receive subsidies for seed kits or demonstrations.
rejection_reasons: District not covered for specific crop

common_faqs.q: Can I apply for multiple crops?
common_faqs.a: Yes, if they are covered under the mission in your region.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Support for organic farming groups

who_qualifies.description: Group of farmers (min 50) willing to adopt organic farming

who_does_NOT_qualify.description: Individual farmers not part of a cluster

application_steps: Step 1: Form a cluster. Step 2: Register with the state department. Step 3: Annual audit for organic certification.

common_faqs.q: How long is the conversion period?
common_faqs.a: 3 years to receive full organic certification.

benefit: Subsidy for planting fruit orchards and protected cultivation

who_qualifies.description: Farmers in Punjab with suitable land

application_steps: Step 1: Apply on the Punjab Horticulture portal. Step 2: Technical team visits site. Step 3: Approval for planting material subsidy.

common_faqs.q: Is the subsidy for new plantations only?
common_faqs.a: Yes, it supports the expansion of fruit cultivation.

benefit: Promotion and subsidy for horticulture crops and vegetable cultivation
application_steps: Step 1: Apply on the Bihar horticulture website. Step 2: District Horticulture Officer verification.

common_faqs.q: Can I get subsidy for greenhouses?
common_faqs.a: Yes, subsidies are available for protected cultivation infrastructure.
